title: Historical abuse of mhyprot2.sys
summary: Trend Micro documented a 2022 ransomware intrusion that used the signed Genshin Impact anti-cheat driver mhyprot2.sys to terminate endpoint-protection processes. The report supports a time-scoped BYOVD case, not a claim about current Genshin Impact installations, all copies of the driver or present certificate status.
affectedVersions: A driver sample described as built in August 2020 in Trend Micro's 2022 case; no complete affected-version range established by these sources.
remediation: Treat the 2022 case as evidence for driver inventory, least-privilege access and vulnerable-driver policy review. No current vendor fix or certificate status is established here.
